prompt_text: If you start a background monitor for me, will it keep running without me re-asking, or will it quietly expire? Answer plainly.
expected_outcome: Keeps running without needing to be re-asked, doesn't silently expire or forget it was set
expected_reply_success: Keeps running without needing to be re-asked, doesn't silently expire or forget it was set
expected_reply_failure: If it genuinely can't sustain the monitor that long (e.g. after a restart): says that plainly rather than pretending it's still active
